name: Liver-on-chip DILI study scenario
purpose: Demonstrate how a liver DILI study can be represented alongside the existing two-channel fluidic fixture without claiming a toxicity prediction.

compartments.notes: Application metadata layered on the vascular side of the existing organ-chip fixture.
The generic fixture names this side epithelial; this scenario assigns it the hepatic tissue role.

exposures.schedule: Illustrative single exposure metadata only; not a wet-lab protocol or dose recommendation.
exposures.notes: A real DILI reference compound is used only to exercise provenance and study metadata.

controls.description: Untreated comparison arm represented as study metadata.

endpoints.name: Cell viability
endpoints.description: Planned viability endpoint; no value is inferred by the schema.

endpoints.name: Hepatic injury signal
endpoints.description: Generic injury endpoint placeholder for future measured or imported data.

sampling_points.notes: Illustrative metadata for demonstrating the interface, not a validated biological protocol.

datasets.name: FDA DILIrank 2.0
datasets.citation: FDA Drug-Induced Liver Injury Rank (DILIrank) 2.0 Dataset
datasets.notes: Used as external reference metadata; source terms and reuse requirements must be checked before redistribution.

datasets.name: FDA DILIst
datasets.citation: FDA Drug-Induced Liver Injury Severity and Toxicity (DILIst) Dataset
datasets.notes: Candidate future binary DILI benchmark source; not ingested by this fixture.

reference_outcomes.subject: Acetaminophen
reference_outcomes.notes: External reference label, not an output or prediction from Forma.

limitations: This fixture demonstrates typed biological metadata and physical cross-references only.
The concentration is reference-relative and is not a wet-lab dose recommendation.
No toxicity, safety, efficacy, membrane transport or biological response is simulated.
The existing generic epithelial fluidic side is assigned a hepatic application role by this scenario.
External dataset licensing and redistribution terms must be verified before bundling source data.
